message.wandscape.town.welcome.zh_cn:
[魔法小镇] 欢迎！按 V 键打开建筑面板，开始建设你的魔法小镇吧！面板打开后，按 C 键抬起鼠标操作界面，按 H 键打开新手教程。
本模组尚在早期版本，自带魔法较少，推荐搭配 irons_spellbooks（铁魔法）游玩。
message.wandscape.town.welcome.en_us:
[Wandscape] Welcome! Press V to open the building panel and start building your town. Once the panel is open, press C to release the mouse and H to open the tutorial.
This mod is still in its early versions with few built-in spells — playing alongside irons_spellbooks (Iron Spells) is recommended.
